# Computer Science

This reference note demonstrates the canonical multi-line card layout.

#### Card With Separate Front

What is entropy in thermodynamics?

It measures how dispersed energy is in a closed system.

:::

A statistical measure of the number of microstates compatible with a macrostate.

Often described informally as disorder, though that metaphor is imperfect.
<!--anki-id: 4803bfd7-9966-44b5-8b75-b7ab45c0df0a-->




#### Heading Is The Front

:::

Dijkstra's algorithm finds shortest paths in graphs with non-negative edge weights.

It uses a priority queue to repeatedly relax the closest unvisited node.
<!--anki-id: 836b0ebd-a46e-48af-95f6-c9e981456a41-->




### Graph Algorithms

#### Shortest Path Without Separate Front

:::

Bellman-Ford handles negative edge weights and detects negative cycles.

It relaxes all edges repeatedly for V-1 iterations.
<!--anki-id: c4590a37-fa7c-4a80-9ae8-c290bc281426-->




#### Another Card In Subsection

What is a spanning tree?

A subset of graph edges connecting all vertices without cycles.

:::

A minimum spanning tree minimizes total edge weight across the tree.
<!--anki-id: 90f5921e-a3f1-4855-a229-aee5295ffc8c-->
